configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH"; mkdir -p artifacts; [ -s artifacts/dev-admin-key ] || openssl rand -hex 12 > artifacts/dev-admin-key; Database__Provider=Sqlite ConnectionStrings__Trivia="Data Source=$PWD/artifacts/trivia-dev.db" Media__Path="$PWD/artifacts/media" Admin__Key="$(cat artifacts/dev-admin-key)" ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://localhost:5080 dotnet run --project src/KnowBall.Api --no-launch-profile
